description: Permissions the frontend needs. Without a capability the frontend cannot use any core API — which is why window.close() silently did nothing. `allow-destroy` is required by onCloseRequested: its handler closes the window itself unless the event was prevented. `allow-start-dragging` is what makes `data-tauri-drag-region` work; without it the toolbar looks draggable and is not. The window list has to name the compose windows too: a capability is scoped to the windows it lists, so a window left out of it cannot call anything at all — not even to listen for its own editor's output. The file dialogs are the shell's (`pick_files`, `save_attachment`), so the page cannot name a path of its own; it keeps `ask` for its confirmations.
